Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.api (event repository_dispatch is not supported by Gitea; the trigger is dropped)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
